Subject: Evidence request: SIG / CAIQ — deployment guardrails crosswalk

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this meeting earlier. As discussed, the assessor team needs a focused crosswalk mapping of your secure deployment controls against SIG/CAIQ. To keep the scope tight, could you please provide the following artifacts by EOD Wednesday (48 hours):

1) Code review sampling: PR IDs (2–3) with reviewer list and timestamps; redacted diffs are fine.
2) CI/CD evidence: job run IDs that show PR gating (lint/test/build) and the job logs for a representative run.
3) Secrets/keystore proof: keystore rotation events (CSV or log), KMS key IDs, and the owner on record.
4) Change management: a brief timeline showing how production deploys are approved (who signs off, any rollback steps).
5) Ephemeral runner inventory and retention policies for runner tokens.

Attached is a SIG evidence template that helps the assessor map artifacts to control objectives (SIG_evidence_template.xlsx). Please point to Drive links where possible (we prefer links with limited-time access). If anything on this list is sensitive, redacted artifacts or secure share links work.

Also please confirm: will this be delivered under Redwood public cloud evidence or the Dedicated environment for FinVault? That determines which logs we need.

Best,
Sam Ortega
Lead Assessor, Clearsky Security Assessments
security-assessor@clearsky.com

Thanks, Jasmine — small technical notes for the assessor to help expedite review:

1) Code review gating: we enforce branch protection on the main and release branches. Typical PRs for this workload require 1 reviewer + CI passing. Example PR IDs (redacted): RW-PR-#4312, RW-PR-#4829. Reviewer handles are in the redacted log.

2) CI evidence: our representative job runs are:
- job run: rw-ci/58422 — shows lint -> unit tests -> integration smoke -> deploy-gate (artifact signing)
- job run: rw-ci/58703 — retry after flaky test; kept for audit purposes.
Sample log excerpt (redacted):

--- BEGIN LOG rw-ci/58422 ---
[00:00:01] checkout commit: 3f2a****
[00:00:12] run: ./scripts/ci-lint.sh
[00:02:44] run: ./scripts/unit-tests.sh
[00:10:31] artifact: bundle.tar.gz signed by: ci-bot@redwood.ai
[00:10:40] deploy-gate: approval_required=true; approvers=[release-engineering]
--- END LOG ---

3) Keystore rotation: rotation events are logged to our key-management ledger. Attached CSV includes timestamps and KMS key aliases. KMS keys are customer-scoped for Dedicated deployments; rotation frequency is quarterly or on-demand per FinVault policy.

4) Change management: for FinVault Dedicated, deploys to prod require:
- PR approved by reviewer + CI green
- Release engineering ticket opened (JIRA ID present in PR metadata)
- Release manager approval via internal release queue (approver email logged)
- Automated canary (10% traffic) followed by metrics check before full rollout

If the assessor needs signed audit logs rather than CSV, we can pull an HSM-signed ledger export — that will take longer (estimate +48 hours).

—
Irene Choi
Staff Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

Attachment references: redacted-pr-log.zip (contains PR metadata); ci-jobs-sample.txt (contains job run IDs + logs).
